_meta.purpose: Third Crossref verification batch (2026-10-02). Metadata for the reference-list expansion from 23 to 54 entries requested for the format-matched revision.
_meta.how_obtained: Each record below was retrieved from the Crossref REST API (api.crossref.org/works, rows=1, field-select) and transcribed verbatim into this file. api.crossref.org is not reachable from the sandbox network (TLS blocked); the queries were issued through the workspace web-fetcher, so the raw responses were recorded here by hand rather than by a script.
_meta.rule: Only records whose DOI was returned by Crossref for the stated query are included. No author, title, journal, volume, page, year or DOI was supplied from memory; the entries rejected by this rule (Lekhnitskii 1963, Savin 1961, Roache 1998, Celik et al. 2008, Nowacki 1986) are listed under _rejected with the reason.

_rejected.reason: Crossref returned only a chapter of Ting's book ('The Lekhnitskii Formalism'), not Lekhnitskii's monograph.
Crossref returned only a 1966 conference chapter, not the monograph 'Stress Concentration Around Holes'.
Crossref returned no record for the Hermosa monograph; replaced by the verified Pelletier & Roache (2000) chapter.
Crossref record 10.1115/1.2960953 carries no author list, so the author field could not be verified.
Crossref returned only individual chapters of 'Thermoelasticity', not the monograph itself.
Not queried: no Crossref record expected for the 1958 Comptes Rendus note.
